title: Prepare a carefree retirement
tagline: Pension gap closed, savings invested, the next generation taken care of.
trigger: Age 50 to 64, steady income and a large balance that isn't working.

steps.title: Your pension gap
steps.description: Your expected statutory pension compared with what you spend today.
steps.why: Based on your salary and spending at KBC.
steps.result: At 67 you can expect about €{pension_est} a month. To keep your lifestyle you need about €{pension_gap} a month more.

steps.title: Pension savings at the tax-optimal amount
steps.description: Pension savings up to the amount that gives the highest tax benefit.
steps.why: Already arranged at KBC? Then there's nothing to do.
steps.result: Pension savings set to €1,050 a year.

steps.title: Put idle savings to work
steps.description: Part of your savings moves to a managed, defensive portfolio. A buffer stays on your savings account.
steps.why: Matched to the investor profile you confirm in the app.

win.customer: Savings that keep up with inflation

steps.result: €{invest_k}k goes to a defensive managed portfolio. €{buffer_k}k stays available as a buffer.

steps.title: A part you manage yourself
steps.description: For the share you want to manage yourself: a Bolero account with your profile pre-filled.
steps.why: KBC group platform; it receives only your investor profile.

win.customer: Freedom for the part you want to steer

steps.result: Bolero account opened with your investor profile pre-filled.

steps.title: One conversation with a private banker
steps.description: Your whole picture in one meeting: pension, house, investments and the children.
steps.why: The banker gets the file KBC already built, so the meeting is about decisions.

win.customer: Decisions in one hour, not five meetings

steps.result: Meeting with a private banker booked. Your file is ready.

steps.title: Help the children, plan the inheritance
steps.description: Gifts to the children now and a plan for later, so they pay less inheritance tax.
steps.why: KBC's Inheritance Planning Service works with notaries.

win.customer: Family taken care of, less tax
win.kbc: Wealth stays in the family and at KBC

steps.result: Gift plan for both children prepared: about €18,000 less inheritance tax (illustrative).

steps.title: Keep your hospital cover after work
steps.description: Your employer's hospitalisation insurance stops when you retire. Continue it now without a medical check.
steps.why: Continuing before retirement avoids a new medical questionnaire.

win.customer: Covered without a new medical check

steps.result: Continuation arranged: your hospital cover runs on after your last working day.
